verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a terminal coding agent, so being an MCP client is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the pack documents a way to register or configure external MCP servers for ByteAsk to use. The only MCP evidence is ByteAsk-Embedded-MCP, a server ByteAsk publishes for other coding agents; that is the server role, not plugging MCP servers into ByteAsk.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
